title: Comindex S.A.
content:
Comindex is a specialty materials distributor serving the Iberian market with additives and performance materials. The company distributes aerogel products for coatings, construction, and insulation-related applications.

  • Coverage Area: Spain, Portugal, and Morocco
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel additives for paints, coatings, insulation materials, and construction formulations
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://www.comindex.es/en
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
